matrix_config.cacheCondition: Fresh application and native process on each request, warm OS file cache; no disk cache clearing
matrix_config.baselineScope: Frozen 1.10.0 algorithms and synchronous HTM candidate delivery with P0 observation plus shared 15-thread quota normalization; immutable original identity retained separately
matrix_config.currentScope: H1 early candidate delivery, Q1 full-strong hot path; rejected H2/Q2 variants remain disabled; non-PGO Portable O3/LTO; QTM initialization pause checkpoints repaired after an existing shallow-state resource failure
matrix_config.rerunScope: One complete replacement matrix after recorded Windows JSON file-sharing interference; initial attempt and pre-repair package retained; artifacts use a separate formal-final directory

persistence_scope: Full checkpoints only before each launcher, after owned process-tree cleanup, and at final exit; raw response events remain in memory during search
